create_PackingIterator: create a PackingIterator that packs BLT sequences into batches using byte or patching mode
build_PackingIteratorState: build a PackingIterator from a serialized PackingIteratorState to resume data iteration
truncate_batch: truncate a Batch to a max length and optionally pad to uniform sequence length
create_PackingArgs: create a PackingArgs config with batch size, sequence length, pad id, and packing mode
merge_patch_seq_masks: merge a list of per-sequence boolean masks into a single batched numpy mask array
